message.content:
To retrieve the CNAME records for **sample.com** via VirusTotal and extract only the object IDs, you can use the following approach (replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your actual key):

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "YOUR_API_KEY"          # <-- put your key here
DOMAIN   = "sample.com"
URL      = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{DOMAIN}/dns_records"

headers = {
    "x-apikey": API_KEY,
}

response = requests.get(URL, headers=headers)
data     = response.json()

# Extract the IDs of all DNS records (CNAMEs included)
record_ids = [record["id"] for record in data.get("data", [])]

print(record_ids)   # This will print a list of IDs
```

**What you’ll see**

Running the script will output a list of IDs, e.g.:

```
['abcd1234', 'efgh5678', ...]
```

These IDs correspond to the individual DNS record objects returned by VirusTotal. If you only want the CNAME records, filter the list further:

```python
cname_ids = [
    record["id"]
    for record in data.get("data", [])
    if record.get("attributes", {}).get("type") == "CNAME"
]
print(cname_ids)
```

This will give you just the IDs of the CNAME records.
